fusions.name: Crossed Lines
fusions.desc: Snags up to 2 enemies within 4 tiles, deals 10 damage to each and turns them against each other for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Light Fingers
fusions.desc: Throws a snatching barb that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 8 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lure in the Reeds
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, and you move 15% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Bait Taken
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.
